property_description: Experience refined coastal living in prestigious Cape Fear National at Brunswick Forest. This light-filled 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath home offers 3,486 square feet of beautifully appointed living space, with hardwood flooring throughout the main level and a thoughtful floor plan designed for both everyday comfort and effortless entertaining. From the moment you enter, the home's inviting character is evident. The spacious living area centers around a fireplace framed by custom built-ins and cabinetry, while a coffered ceiling adds architectural interest and an elegant touch. The formal dining area provides a gracious setting for gatherings, and fresh paint, updated lighting, and new ceiling fans enhance the home's bright, polished feel. The generous kitchen is sure to impress with gorgeous countertops, a large island with bar seating, updated stainless steel appliances, and a convenient casual breakfast nook. Just beyond, the glass-enclosed sunroom offers a serene retreat for morning coffee, reading, or relaxing while enjoying the coastal surroundings. With its own heating and cooling mini-split, this versatile space can be enjoyed throughout the seasons and opens directly to the rear patio, where a Napoleon Prestige gas grill makes outdoor entertaining a breeze. The spacious primary suite is a true retreat, featuring a tray ceiling and large carpeted bedroom. The luxurious en suite bath offers dual sinks, a soaking tub, walk-in shower, and an expansive walk-in closet. A comfortable guest bedroom and full bath are also located downstairs, along with an enhanced home office enclosed by a glass French door. The office provides a quiet, private workspace while offering the flexibility to accommodate overnight guests when needed. Upstairs, a finished flex space with its own full bathroom adds valuable versatility as a guest suite, media room, hobby space, or additional living area. Practical updates provide peace of mind, including a new main HVAC system installed in 2024 and a whole-home Generac generator complete with an existing maintenance agreement through July 2028. The freshly refinished garage floor adds a clean, finished touch to the generous garage space. Beautifully maintained and thoughtfully updated, this exceptional Cape Fear National home within walking distance to the Cape Fear National golf course offers the space, flexibility, comfort, and indoor-outdoor living sought by those embracing the Brunswick Forest lifestyle.

property_description: A private country setting with the convenience of being just minutes from Downtown Waxhaw! Set on 2.5 acres, this spacious 3-bedroom ranch offers plenty of room to spread out, with a thoughtful renovation that makes the home feel fresh, open, and inviting. The major renovation created an open floor plan with an updated kitchen and bathrooms, new 12mm laminate Hickory wood flooring throughout, fresh paint, and new light fixtures. The great room features a vaulted ceiling and a spectacular stacked-stone, wood-burning fireplace that creates a warm focal point for the space. Kitchen has beautful new York chocolate cabinets, granite countertops and stainless steel appliances including a gas range, The split-bedroom layout provides privacy, with the primary suite on one side of the home and the secondary bedrooms and full bath on the other. A half bath was added to the laundry room, making this space even more functional. Step outside onto the newly painted, oversized deck overlooking the large, private backyard with 12 x 12 storage shed. The back deck is an ideal spot to enjoy the peace and privacy of the property. A newly installed crushed-asphalt driveway with a half-circle provides plenty of parking, with room for approximately 10 cars in addition to the 2-car garage. Recent improvements also include a new well water tank, new well pump, a septic pump that is less than five years old with a lifetime warranty, and a whole-house water softener. If you've been looking for space, privacy, and a home that's close to everything Waxhaw has to offer, this one is worth seeing. Enjoy the quiet of acreage and country living while being only minutes from the shops, restaurants, and charm of historic Downtown Waxhaw-all with NO HOA restrictions! And NO CITY TAXES!
